notes: Account-specific FTP absolute path supplied in conversation; intentionally omitted from this public GitHub file. Public-relative path web/kmhn confirmed. TLS verified. No real PHP hosting or MCP end-to-end deployment.
deployment_blocker: Owner confirmed FTP absolute root (web) and kmhn docroot. Need SSH to verify web-root realpath and non-Web private path writable and PHP-readable. Do not deploy to a guessed path or FTP-root sibling.

provisioning.note: Owner explicitly confirmed mcp-kmhn.landco.co.jp and SSL setup. Treat as configured, not as proof of publicly reachable TLS or a deployed MCP endpoint.
provisioning.full_path_confidentiality: Exact absolute account path is kept out of this public repository; use local SSH/private deployment variable.

tls_verification.limitation: This validates TLS hostname and chain from one runner, NOT deployed PHP runtime or MCP protocol.

public_root_type: FTP account full path is the web document root; owner-confirmed, not independently inspected over SSH
private_runtime_layout: An SSH-accessible directory OUTSIDE the FTP root and any other HTTP document root; do not assume an FTP-root sibling is private
layout_strategy: Only bootstrap index.php and .htaccess under FTP root/kmhn. Place original universal/server tree outside HTTP roots and require its absolute entrypoint from bootstrap.

ftp_root.scope: account-local only; never commit absolute full path
